objective: Score candidate opportunity universes through an explicit, reproducible and rights-aware commercial selection gate.
outcome: Seven candidate universes are scored against weighted buyer, rights, access, epistemic, product, cost and regulatory criteria with documented official evidence and fail-closed knockout rules.

skills.activation_reason: Own the comparative universe gate and prevent breadth-first selection.
Keep commercial assumptions testable and bounded.
Assess credible source-rights and machine-access paths without admitting sources.
Recompute weighted scores and enforce knockout thresholds.
Preserve Global Opportunity Intelligence and observation-not-advice boundaries.

external: No source-specific legal approval inferred from general EU reuse policy

prohibited_scope: Public marketing of an unsupported universe

acceptance_evidence.description: Machine-readable candidate scorecard with seven candidates and weighted criteria.
Official source and reuse references are attached to candidates without claiming source admission.
Verifier recomputes scores, validates knockout rules and checks task instances against the task schema.
ADR-012 records the durable wedge decision and its non-admission boundary.

alerts: PRODUCT_ADMITTED state introduced by selection package

rollback.strategy: Revert the scorecard decision commit and mark the decision REJECTED or SUPERSEDED while preserving its audit history.
rollback.kill_switch: All selected-universe runtime and public-marketing states remain disabled until independent source and universe admission gates pass.

goal_lock_checks.evidence: The scoring favours a workflow that moves from discovery to official notice evidence.
No candidate score creates canonical claims; provenance requirements remain mandatory.
Geography, buyer relationships, awards and notice history are explicit selection criteria.
Buyer demand scores guide product selection but are not economic evidence.
The selected official EU source family is multilingual by architecture and preserves source-language fields.
Structured notice history, changes, buyer graphs and evidence lineage differentiate the workflow from generic AI search.
The selected workflow is observation and research; bid execution and personalised advice are prohibited.
Rights clarity and official machine access are knockout criteria.
The decision and every future source can be disabled independently and superseded audibly.
The task advances the explicitly authorised F8 universe-selection gate.
